purpose: Machine-searchable factual preparation, not a final method Word, new rule implementation, or full-reproduction success claim.

ordered_stages.stage: Valid narrative fragments and within-report deduplication
ordered_stages.implementation: normalize_text/clean_segment/split_korean_sentences first. Narrative length25..700, at least15Hangul characters and5tokens; table-noise tests remain. A digital keyword can rescue a noisy input line from one preliminary skip, not bypass final narrative validity. score_one then deduplicates by ''.join(sentence.lower().split()), keeps first text/order, and classifies every retained fragment.

ordered_stages.stage: Digital-related flag, not an independent preprocessing candidate sample
ordered_stages.implementation: v2 combines strong/online/automation/data/platform/software triggers, hard-nondigital gates and final charter/fourth-industrial-revolution flag overrides. Exact48v2regex and their original IGNORECASE flags are retained. DIGITAL_CORE_TERMS is not a global requirement that removes every other valid sentence before classification.

ordered_stages.stage: Provisional substantive digital gate and attribution proxy
ordered_stages.implementation: strategy_relevance AND action AND attributable, where actions/implementation/active operation, company-name tokens/pronouns and generic/external contexts are lexical proxies within the supplied fragment. This is not entity linking, cross-sentence coreference resolution, factual verification of execution, or external confirmation of firm behavior.

ordered_stages.stage: Specific-plan override occurs after earlier v2 exclusions
ordered_stages.implementation: specific_plan requires the coded technology/plan/focal/IMPLEMENTED and exclusion conditions. If specific_plan and not stale, substantive is setTrue again. Therefore the earlier exclusion checks must not be described as an irreversible early-return veto. Plan/action regexes include prospective expressions; the code cannot establish real-world completion.

After substantive passes, DIRECT_BMI or BMI-with-customer/revenue or SMART_PRODUCT or digital-platform-with-value triggers BMODD. These are lexical business-model-scope triggers, not a trained semantic model.

ordered_stages.stage: Final v4 exclusions have priority over v2 positives
ordered_stages.implementation: v4 first obtains originalv2labels, then evaluates its own original supplied sentence without adding v2's whitespace normalization. Sixteen v4compiledregex are case-sensitive. implementation_evidence=active_clean AND(focal OR high_confidence_action). The listed market/external/static/segment/platform/missing-implementation/vague/demand/customer-competitor/former/accounting/history vetoes zero substantive,BMODD,market-signal flags; nondigital_platform also zeros digital/boilerplate. There is no later promotion back to substantive/BMODD.

Public BMODD uses internal bmi_sentence_v2==1 first; otherwise NonBMODD if substantive_digital_sentence_v2==1; otherwise Exclude. NonBMODD is the residual substantive category, not a separately trained or independently coded internal-digitization classifier. Exclude contains both non-digital fragments and digital-related but non-substantive fragments.

D=all valid deduplicated fragments, C=digital flags, S=substantive flags, B=BMODD flags. Current wrapper checks0<=B<=S<=C<=D and category counts. NonBMODD_count=S-B; Exclude_count=D-S. Ratios are B/D,(S-B)/D,S/D for D>0. Original estimator's residual clip(lower=0) is documented, not a license to repair contradictory counts. Missing raw input is a failed execution, not a zero disclosure observation.

codebook_vs_implementation: Human codebook defines conceptual coding standards; the actual Python implementation uses the exact keyword/regex/metadata/window/order checks catalogued here. Do not claim unimplemented semantic recognition or use coder agreement as classifier accuracy.
